description: This file is a shell script used as a DHCP hook script for dnsmasq in a network service setup. It processes DHCP events such as add, delete, old, and ARP updates, constructs JSON data, and sends it via ubus calls to handle network events.

methods.name: json_add_array
methods.description: Adds a new array to a JSON object.

methods.name: json_add_string
methods.description: Adds a string key-value pair to a JSON object or array.

methods.name: json_dump
methods.description: Serializes the JSON object to a string.
